findings.failure_path: base-attestation-1.txt and -2.txt are byte-identical (identical blob 6f65efc). A gate requiring two attestations is satisfied by copying one file, so a single stale or wrong observation of origin/dev passes as two independent confirmations; the attesting party is also the gated party, with no signature, observer id, or timestamp distinguishing them.
findings.smallest_fix: Require each attestation to embed a distinct capture timestamp/observer and reject identical blob hashes between attestation files.

findings.failure_path: The attestation is unverifiable plain text pasted by the implementer: nothing in the diff cross-checks that bcdd82a is an ancestor of HEAD or the current origin/dev tip at merge time. If dev advances after the file is written the recorded base is stale yet the gated 'base bound' outcome is still reached; a hand-typed SHA that never existed on dev also passes.
findings.smallest_fix: Add an executable check running git ls-remote origin refs/heads/dev, comparing to the attestation file, and asserting git merge-base --is-ancestor <sha> HEAD.

findings.failure_path: No added or modified test asserts version equality across package.json, lockfile root, and lockfile packages['']; the consistency claim comes only from an ad-hoc Node snippet in evidence. A future bump that updates package.json but misses a lockfile field reproduces the version skew with all 166 tests green.
findings.smallest_fix: Add a test asserting package.json version === lockfile version === lockfile packages[''].version.

findings.failure_path: Acceptance requires both suites to pass on the exact committed candidate, but the cited runs predate commit de0dc28 (the evidence commit). The 0.11.0 pack artifact metadata was produced from a different tree than the reviewed HEAD, so anything slipped into that later commit is untested.
findings.smallest_fix: Re-run npm test and npm run test:pack at HEAD de0dc28 and record the SHA with the results.

concern_results.conclusion: Bypasses found: the two 'independent' base attestations are byte-identical blobs (both 6f65efc), so the duplicate-attestation gate fires on a single copy-paste and is self-adjudicated by the implementer; the ls-remote lines carry no timestamp, signature, or observer identity, so a stale or fabricated line reaches the gated 'base bound' outcome without any upstream fetch. Version metadata itself is consistent (three 0.11.0 values), but nothing in the diff enforces it — no test or check is added, so the gate rests on out-of-band claims. Test evidence (166 + 11 pass) was collected on the package-bearing commit, not the committed HEAD de0dc28, contradicting acceptance item 3.
